body.name: Ordinary-design embedding \(\iota\) on \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\)
body.construction: For \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}=(G,S_0,x_0,(\kappa_v)_{v\in V})\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), set the Layer-2.5 target to \(Q=P((S_0)_{x_0}=s_0)\) and let \(G^{+}\) retain the ordinary node mechanisms. The catalogue has one mandatory fresh-unit SELECT \(s\) with \(c(s)=0\); for every \(v\in V\), one RAND action \(r_v\) that draws independently and uniformly from \(\mathfrak X_v\), affects exactly the ordinary children of \(v\), and costs \(c(r_v)=\kappa_v\); and one READ action \(\rho_v\) with endpoint \(v\) and cost zero. SELECT precedes every other action, remaining actions follow canonical causal order, and there are no conflicts or CTF-RAND actions. For \(B\subseteq V\), let \(S_B=\{s\}\cup\{r_v:v\in B\}\cup\{\rho_v:v\in V\}\). Conditioning its independent RAND labels at \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\) produces the Layer-2.5 translation of the ordinary source \(Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b)=P_b(V\setminus B)\), with positive label probability and protocol cost \(\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v\). The source interface returns for each \(S_B\) an immutable handle for this complete ordinary experimental law and its exact support table; because each RAND coordinate is uniform, every assignment-label event has positive support. Oracle answers for protocols outside the SELECT-RAND-READ image are irrelevant to the embedding.
